examples.chinese: 他常常幫朋友，是一個好人。
examples.pinyin: Tā chángcháng bāng péngyǒu, shì yí ge hǎo rén.
examples.english: He helps his friends often. He is a nice guy.

examples.chinese: 你要找什麼？我幫你找。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào zhǎo shénme? Wǒ bāng nǐ zhǎo.
examples.english: What do you want to look for? I can help you.

examples.chinese: 沙發上面、下面跟旁邊都沒有。媽，妳幫我找，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: Shāfā shàngmiàn, xiàmiàn gēn pángbiān dōu méiyǒu. Mā, nǐ bāng wǒ zhǎo, hǎo ma?
examples.english: It is neither on the sofa, under the sofa, nor beside the sofa. Mom, could you find it for me?

examples.chinese: 這本雜誌有點兒舊，我幫你買一本新的吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn zázhì yǒudiǎnr jiù, wǒ bāng nǐ mǎi yī běn xīn de ba.
examples.english: This magazine is a bit old; let me help you buy a new one.

examples.chinese: 可以請你幫我一個忙嗎？
examples.pinyin: Kěyǐ qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ yí ge máng ma?
examples.english: Can I ask you to help me with a favor?

examples.chinese: 我弟弟很喜歡幫人照相。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi hěn xǐhuān bāng rén zhàoxiàng.
examples.english: My younger brother really likes to help people take photos.

examples.chinese: 我弟弟很喜歡幫人照相。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi hěn xǐhuān bāng rén zhàoxiàng.
examples.english: My younger brother really likes to help people take photos.

examples.chinese: 這件事情他自己可以做，不需要我們幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqíng tā zìjǐ kěyǐ zuò, bù xūyào wǒmen bāngmáng.
examples.english: He can do this matter himself; he doesn't need our help.

examples.chinese: 公園的音樂晚會快要開始了，可不可以請你們幫我排那些椅子？
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán de yīnyuè wǎnhuì kuài yào kāishǐ le, kě bù kěyǐ qǐng nǐmen bāng wǒ pái nàxiē yǐzi?
examples.english: The park's music evening party is about to start; could you please help me line up those chairs?

examples.chinese: 你先幫我付，我明天再給你錢。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bāng wǒ fù, wǒ míngtiān zài gěi nǐ qián.
examples.english: You pay for me first; I'll give you the money tomorrow.

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: 小王手裡提著那麼多東西，好像很重，我們過去幫他提一些吧！
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng shǒu lǐ tízhe nàme duō dōngxi, hǎoxiàng hěn zhòng, wǒmen guòqù bāng tā tí yīxiē ba!
examples.english: Xiao Wang is carrying so many things in his hands; they look heavy. Let's go over and help him carry some!

examples.chinese: 小黃要去便利商店領錢， 我請他幫我買杯咖啡。老闆去歐洲旅遊回來，買了荷蘭傳統的點心送給大家，叫我們去助理那裡領。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Huáng yào qù biànlì shāngdiàn lǐng qián, wǒ qǐng tā bāng wǒ mǎi bēi kāfēi. Lǎobǎn qù Ōuzhōu lǚyóu huílái, mǎile Hélán chuántǒng de diǎnxin sòng gěi dàjiā, jiào wǒmen qù zhùlǐ nàlǐ lǐng.
examples.english: Xiao Huang is going to the convenience store to withdraw money; I asked him to buy me a cup of coffee. The boss came back from a trip to Europe and bought traditional Dutch snacks to give to everyone, and told us to pick them up from the assistant.

examples.chinese: 舅舅對我很好，不管我遇到什麼挑戰，只要跟他說一聲，他一定會幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Jiùjiu duì wǒ hěn hǎo, bùguǎn wǒ yùdào shénme tiǎozhàn, zhǐyào gēn tā shuō yì shēng, tā yídìng huì bāngmáng.
examples.english: My uncle is very good to me; no matter what challenges I encounter, as long as I give him a mention, he will definitely help.

examples.chinese: 你回家經過賣韓國貨的超市時，可以順便幫我買兩包泡麵嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huíjiā jīngguò mài Hánguó huò de chāoshì shí, kěyǐ shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi liǎng bāo pàomiàn ma?
examples.english: When you pass by the supermarket that sells Korean merchandise on your way home, can you conveniently buy me two packs of instant noodles?

examples.chinese: 客人：這雙皮鞋我穿起來太緊了， 可以幫我換大一點的嗎？ 店員：沒問題，我幫你拿大一號的。
examples.pinyin: Kèrén: Zhè shuāng píxié wǒ chuān qǐlái tài jǐn le, kěyǐ bāng wǒ huàn dà yīdiǎn de ma? Diànyuán: Méi wèntí, wǒ bāng nǐ ná dà yī hào de.
examples.english: Customer: This pair of leather shoes is too tight for me; can you help me exchange them for a bigger size? Clerk: No problem, I'll get you a size larger.

examples.chinese: 張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼。我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng cháng bāng tàitai mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, yàoshi bǐ tàitai zǎo xiàbān, hái huì bǎ wǎncān zuò hǎo, zhēn tǐtiē. Wǒ tóngxué hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, jīngcháng zhǔfàn, zuò jiāshì, bāng le fùmǔ bùshǎo máng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang often helps his wife buy groceries and wash clothes; if he gets off work earlier than his wife, he also makes dinner—he is truly considerate. My classmate is very considerate of his parents; he often cooks and does housework, helping his parents a lot.

examples.chinese: 因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了。不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu rén hējiǔ hòu kāichē, zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng yìwài, jǐngchá hé jiùhùchē dōu gǎnlái le. Bùguǎn chūguó gōngzuò huò liúxué, yīdìng děi mǎi gè píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài cái néng dédào bāngzhù.
examples.english: Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over. Whether going abroad to work or study, you must buy safety insurance so that in case any accident happens, you can get help.

examples.chinese: 臺灣人在國外碰到問題時，可以立刻打0800-085-095「你幫我，你救我」這支電話求救。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān rén zài guówài pèngdào wèntí shí, kěyǐ lìkè dǎ 0800-085-095 “nǐ bāng wǒ, nǐ jiù wǒ” zhè zhī diànhuà qiújiù.
examples.english: When Taiwanese people encounter problems abroad, they can immediately call 0800-085-095, the “you help me, you save me” number, to ask for help.

examples.chinese: 只有集合大家的力量，有錢出錢、有力出力，才能幫助災民早一點恢復正常生活。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu jíhé dàjiā de lìliàng, yǒu qián chū qián, yǒu lì chū lì, cái néng bāngzhù zāimín zǎo yìdiǎn huīfù zhèngcháng shēnghuó.
examples.english: Only by gathering everyone's strength—those with money contributing money, those with strength contributing strength—can we help the disaster victims return to normal life sooner.

examples.chinese: 九二一大地震時，臺灣人發揮了互相幫助的精神，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn shí, Táiwān rén fāhuī le hùxiāng bāngzhù de jīngshén, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: During the 921 earthquake, Taiwanese people brought out the spirit of helping one another, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 大寶明年有去英國留學的打算，所以找了家庭教師幫他補習， 希望提高英文程度。
examples.pinyin: Dàbǎo míngnián yǒu qù Yīngguó liúxué de dǎsuàn, suǒyǐ zhǎo le jiātíng jiàoshī bāng tā bǔxí, xīwàng tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù.
examples.english: Dabao plans to study abroad in the UK next year, so he found a private tutor to help him with cram tutoring, hoping to improve his English level.

examples.chinese: 在國外留學的時候，小史是我最好的兄弟，我們總是互相照顧、互相幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài liúxué de shíhou, Xiǎo Shǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de xiōngdì, wǒmen zǒngshì hùxiāng zhàogù, hùxiāng bāngmáng.
examples.english: When I was studying abroad, Xiao Shi was my best brother; we always took care of each other and helped each other.

examples.chinese: 在所有的同事中，我覺得小周最好相處了。他的性格開朗、說話幽默，還常主動幫忙，跟他相處起來很愉快、很自在。
examples.pinyin: Zài suǒyǒu de tóngshì zhōng, wǒ juéde Xiǎo Zhōu zuì hǎo xiāngchǔ le. Tā de xìnggé kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, hái cháng zhǔdòng bāngmáng, gēn tā xiāngchǔ qǐlái hěn yúkuài, hěn zìzài.
examples.english: Among all my colleagues, I think Xiao Zhou is the easiest to get along with. He has a cheerful personality, speaks humorously, and often offers help proactively; getting along with him is very pleasant and relaxed.

examples.chinese: 真正的朋友會幫助你、關心你，是絕對不會傷害你的。青少年常因為不了解而誤會父母的教育方式，或許等他們長大了，就能真正明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu huì bāngzhù nǐ, guānxīn nǐ, shì juéduì bù huì shānghài nǐ de. Qīngshàonián cháng yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér wùhuì fùmǔ de jiàoyù fāngshì, huòxǔ děng tāmen zhǎngdà le, jiù néng zhēnzhèng míngbai le.
examples.english: True friends will help you and care about you; they will absolutely not hurt you. Teenagers often misunderstand their parents' way of education because they don't understand; perhaps when they grow up, they will truly understand.

examples.chinese: 那位老太太年紀大了，沒辦法照顧他的狗，所以想幫狗找個新主人。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎotàitai niánjì dà le, méi bànfǎ zhàogù tā de gǒu, suǒyǐ xiǎng bāng gǒu zhǎo ge xīn zhǔrén.
examples.english: That old lady is advanced in age and has no way to take care of her dog, so she wants to find a new owner for the dog.

examples.chinese: 這個教材比較難，老師怕學生不容易吸收，因此利用各種教學工具來幫助學生學習。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiàocái bǐjiào nán, lǎoshī pà xuéshēng bù róngyì xīshōu, yīncǐ lìyòng gè zhǒng jiàoxué gōngjù lái bāngzhù xuéshēng xuéxí.
examples.english: This textbook is rather difficult; the teacher was afraid students wouldn't easily absorb it, therefore used various teaching tools to help students learn.

examples.chinese: 員工：謝謝您幫了我一個大忙，這個小禮物請您收下。 主管：你太客氣了！這點兒小事真的沒什麼。
examples.pinyin: Yuángōng: Xièxie nín bāng le wǒ yī gè dà máng, zhège xiǎo lǐwù qǐng nín shōuxià. Zhǔguǎn: Nǐ tài kèqì le! Zhè diǎnr xiǎoshì zhēn de méishénme.
examples.english: Employee: Thank you for doing me a big favor; please accept this small gift. Supervisor: You're too polite! This little thing really is nothing serious.

examples.chinese: A:要不是你幫忙，現在我還找不到工作呢！ B:沒什麼，朋友之間本來就應該互相幫助。
examples.pinyin: A: Yàobùshì nǐ bāngmáng, xiànzài wǒ hái zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò ne! B: Méi shénme, péngyǒu zhījiān běnlái jiù yīnggāi hùxiāng bāngzhù.
examples.english: A: If it weren't for your help, I still wouldn't have found a job now! B: It's nothing; between friends, we should help each other by nature.

examples.chinese: 許經理有兩點值得我們學習，第一點是做事仔細，第二點是有耐心。你的白襯衫上面有一個黑點，快脫下來，我幫你洗一洗。
examples.pinyin: Xǔ jīnglǐ yǒu liǎng diǎn zhídé wǒmen xuéxí, dì yī diǎn shì zuòshì zǐxì, dì èr diǎn shì yǒu nàixīn. Nǐ de bái chènshān shàngmiàn yǒu yī gè hēi diǎn, kuài tuō xiàlái, wǒ bāng nǐ xǐ yī xǐ.
examples.english: Manager Xu has two points worth learning from: the first point is that he is careful in his work, and the second point is that he is patient. There is a black spot on your white shirt; quickly take it off, and I'll help you wash it.

examples.chinese: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english: The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 我打工的餐廳一到週末就客滿，忙不過來的時候，連老闆的叔叔都得來幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎgōng de cāntīng yí dào zhōumò jiù kèmǎn, máng bú guòlái de shíhou, lián lǎobǎn de shūshu dōu děi lái bāngmáng.
examples.english: The restaurant where I work part-time is full every weekend; when they are too busy to manage, even the boss's uncle has to come help.

examples.chinese: 你忙不過來的時候就該找人幫忙，別讓自己累壞了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ máng bú guòlái de shíhou jiù gāi zhǎo rén bāngmáng, bié ràng zìjǐ lèihuài le.
examples.english: When you are too busy to manage, you should find someone to help; don't let yourself get exhausted.

examples.chinese: 以電腦系統取代傳統收停車費的方式，能幫老闆節省工作人員的費用。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ diànnǎo xìtǒng qǔdài chuántǒng shōu tíngchē fèi de fāngshì, néng bāng lǎobǎn jiéshěng gōngzuò rényuán de fèiyòng.
examples.english: Replacing the traditional method of collecting parking fees with a computer system can help the boss save on staff costs.

examples.chinese: 鄰居有急事得出門處理，請我暫時幫他照顧孩子。
examples.pinyin: Línjū yǒu jíshì děi chūmén chǔlǐ, qǐng wǒ zànshí bāng tā zhàogù háizi.
examples.english: My neighbor had an urgent matter to go out and handle, so she asked me to temporarily help take care of her child.

examples.chinese: 幸虧你來幫忙，要不然我一個人絕對忙不過來。幸虧我把資料都存在雲端，要不然找不到隨身碟，怎麼開會呢？
examples.pinyin: 1. Xìngkuī nǐ lái bāngmáng, yàobùrán wǒ yí ge rén juéduì máng bú guòlái. 2. Xìngkuī wǒ bǎ zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, yàobùrán zhǎo bú dào suíshēndié, zěnme kāihuì ne?
examples.english: 1. Thanks to your help, otherwise I definitely wouldn't be able to handle it alone. 2. Fortunately, I saved all the data in the cloud; otherwise, if I couldn't find the USB drive, how could we have the meeting?

examples.chinese: 像食物銀行、愛心冰箱此類處理食物的做法，不但可以節省資源，還能幫助需要的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng shíwù yínháng, àixīn bīngxiāng cǐ lèi chǔlǐ shíwù de zuòfǎ, bùdàn kěyǐ jiéshěng zīyuán, hái néng bāngzhù xūyào de rén.
examples.english: This kind of approach to handling food, such as food banks and love refrigerators, not only can save resources but also can help people in need.

examples.chinese: 我們去問老師，也許他可以幫你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen qù wèn lǎoshī, yěxǔ tā kěyǐ bāng nǐ.
examples.english: Let’s ask the teacher; maybe he can help you.

examples.chinese: 好，希望老師可以幫我。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo, xīwàng lǎoshī kěyǐ bāng wǒ.
examples.english: Okay, I hope the teacher has some good ideas.

examples.chinese: 他打電話跟我說，他不能來上課，請我幫他請假。
examples.pinyin: Tā dǎ diànhuà gēn wǒ shuō, tā bù néng lái shàngkè, qǐng wǒ bāng tā qǐngjià.
examples.english: He gave me a call and told me that he couldn’t make it to class and asked me to ask for a leave for him.

examples.chinese: 去年生日爸爸送了我一輛自行車，從那天起，我就天天騎著它去上學。
examples.pinyin: Qùnián shēngrì bàba sòng le wǒ yī liàng zìxíngchē, cóng nà tiān qǐ, wǒ jiù tiāntiān qí zhe tā qù shàngxué.
examples.english: Last year on my birthday, Dad gave me a bicycle; from that day on, I have ridden it to school every day.

examples.chinese: 我承認你的照相機是被我弄壞的，我一定負責把它修理好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chéngrèn nǐ de zhàoxiàngjī shì bèi wǒ nòng huài de, wǒ yīdìng fùzé bǎ tā xiūlǐ hǎo.
examples.english: I admit that your camera was broken by me; I will definitely take responsibility for fixing it.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己的語言和文字，也用它們來記錄歷史。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ de yǔyán hé wénzì, yě yòng tāmen lái jìlù lìshǐ.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own language and writing, and also uses them to record history.

examples.chinese: 博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的。每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。
examples.pinyin: 1. Bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi fēicháng bǎoguì, tāmen jùyǒu mínzú hé wénhuà de jiàzhí, méi bànfǎ yòng qián suàn qīngchu de. 2. Měi gè rén de shēngmìng jiàzhí dōu shì yīyàng de, bù yīnggāi wèile zìjǐ de lìyì ér xīshēng biérén.
examples.english: 1. The things in the museum are very precious; they have ethnic and cultural value and cannot be calculated clearly with money. 2. Everyone's value of life is the same; one should not sacrifice others for one's own interests.

examples.chinese: 我的鞋底快要掉下來了，得去店裡請人把它粘起來。他不管我忙不忙，老是黏著我聊天，讓我覺得有點煩。夏天的時候容易流汗，讓衣服變得黏黏的，真不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de xiédǐ kuàiyào diào xiàlái le, děi qù diànlǐ qǐng rén bǎ tā zhān qǐlái. Tā bùguǎn wǒ máng bù máng, lǎoshì niánzhe wǒ liáotiān, ràng wǒ juéde yǒudiǎn fán. Xiàtiān de shíhou róngyì liúhàn, ràng yīfu biànde niánnián de, zhēn bù shūfu.
examples.english: My shoe sole is about to fall off; I need to go to the shop and ask someone to glue it back on. Regardless of whether I'm busy or not, he's always clinging to me to chat, which makes me feel a bit annoyed. In summer, it's easy to sweat, making clothes sticky, which is really uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 奶奶把變黃的蔬菜葉子埋在地裡，讓它變成草地的營養。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai bǎ biàn huáng de shūcài yèzi mái zài dì lǐ, ràng tā biànchéng cǎodì de yíngyǎng.
examples.english: Grandma buried the yellowed vegetable leaves in the ground, letting them become nutrition for the lawn.

examples.chinese: 這些帶子是我小學的記錄，我請朋友把它存進電腦裡。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē dàizi shì wǒ xiǎoxué de jìlù, wǒ qǐng péngyǒu bǎ tā cún jìn diànnǎo lǐ.
examples.english: These tapes are records from my elementary school days; I asked a friend to save them onto the computer.

examples.chinese: 這部電影的字幕翻譯得很糟糕，讓人弄不清楚它的意思。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de zìmù fānyì de hěn zāogāo, ràng rén nòng bù qīngchǔ tā de yìsi.
examples.english: The subtitles of this movie are translated very poorly, making it unclear what it means.

examples.chinese: 這部電腦的鍵盤有幾個鍵壞了，我得找人修理它。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànnǎo de jiànpán yǒu jǐ ge jiàn huài le, wǒ děi zhǎo rén xiūlǐ tā.
examples.english: Several keys on this computer's keyboard are broken; I need to find someone to repair it.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，有人說夏天開冷氣不如開除溼機，不過有專家表示，它們的功能無法互相取代。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, yǒu rén shuō xiàtiān kāi lěngqì bùrú kāi chúshījī, bùguò yǒu zhuānjiā biǎoshì, tāmen de gōngnéng wúfǎ hùxiāng qǔdài.
examples.english: In Taiwan, some people say that in summer, turning on the air conditioner is not as good as turning on a dehumidifier, but some experts say that their functions cannot replace each other.

examples.chinese: 為了做這個報告，經理已經跟我們開過三次會了。
examples.pinyin: Wèile zuò zhège bàogào, jīnglǐ yǐjīng gēn wǒmen kāi guò sān cì huì le.
examples.english: In order to prepare this report, the manager has already had meetings with us three times.

examples.chinese: 開會的時候，我跟教授的研究想法不同，所以我想跟他討論一下。
examples.pinyin: Kāihuì de shíhou, wǒ gēn jiàoshòu de yánjiū xiǎngfǎ bùtóng, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng gēn tā tǎolùn yīxià.
examples.english: During the meeting, my research thoughts were different from the professor's, so I want to discuss it with him.

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理提到公司打算做市場研究，希望大家下次能發表自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ tí dào gōngsī dǎsuàn zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, xīwàng dàjiā xiàcì néng fābiǎo zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: At today's meeting, the manager mentioned that the company plans to do market research, and hopes everyone can express their own ideas next time.

examples.chinese: 就要開會了，可是我同事還沒把新產品的說明資料準備好，真叫人緊張。
examples.pinyin: Jiù yào kāihuì le, kěshì wǒ tóngshì hái méi bǎ xīn chǎnpǐn de shuōmíng zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo, zhēn jiào rén jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: The meeting is about to start, but my colleague still hasn't prepared the explanatory materials for the new product, which really makes one nervous.

examples.chinese: 這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化。張老闆開會開得太久，沒趕上飛機，只好花錢再買一張機票了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lùyíng huódòng yīnwèi táifēng bàn bù chéng le, kěyǐ shuō jìhuà yǒngyuǎn méi bànfǎ gǎnshàng biànhuà. Zhāng lǎobǎn kāihuì kāi de tài jiǔ, méi gǎnshàng fēijī, zhǐhǎo huā qián zài mǎi yī zhāng jīpiào le.
examples.english: This camping activity couldn't be held because of the typhoon; you could say that plans can never catch up with changes. Boss Zhang's meeting went on too long, and he didn't catch the plane, so he had no choice but to spend money to buy another ticket.

examples.chinese: 開會時如果老闆突然變得很安靜，也不表達任何意見時，就表示他生氣了。
examples.pinyin: Kāihuì shí rúguǒ lǎobǎn tūrán biàn de hěn ānjìng, yě bù biǎodá rènhé yìjiàn shí, jiù biǎoshì tā shēngqì le.
examples.english: If during a meeting the boss suddenly becomes very quiet and doesn't express any opinion, it shows that he is angry.

examples.chinese: 王老闆老是要求員工隨時配合他開會、加班、出差，真教人受不了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎobǎn lǎoshì yāoqiú yuángōng suíshí pèihé tā kāihuì, jiābān, chūchāi, zhēn jiào rén shòu bù liǎo.
examples.english: Boss Wang is always requiring his employees to cooperate with him at any time for meetings, overtime, and business trips; it really makes people unable to stand it.

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理表面上對老闆很客氣，其實心裡很不高興。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ biǎomiàn shàng duì lǎobǎn hěn kèqi, qíshí xīnlǐ hěn bù gāoxìng.
examples.english: During the meeting today, the manager was superficially very polite to the boss, but actually he was very unhappy inside.

examples.chinese: 我等一下要開會，不方便接電話，有事就用手機傳訊息給我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ děng yīxià yào kāihuì, bù fāngbiàn jiē diànhuà, yǒu shì jiù yòng shǒujī chuán xùnxí gěi wǒ.
examples.english: I have a meeting in a little while, so it's not convenient to answer the phone; if there's anything, just send me a message on my cell phone.

examples.chinese: 明天的會議資料我已經上傳到雲端，請各位開會前先了解要討論的內容。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì zīliào wǒ yǐjīng shàngchuán dào yúnduān, qǐng gèwèi kāihuì qián xiān liǎojiě yào tǎolùn de nèiróng.
examples.english: I have already uploaded tomorrow's meeting materials to the cloud; please understand the content to be discussed before the meeting.

examples.chinese: 幸虧你來幫忙，要不然我一個人絕對忙不過來。幸虧我把資料都存在雲端，要不然找不到隨身碟，怎麼開會呢？
examples.pinyin: 1. Xìngkuī nǐ lái bāngmáng, yàobùrán wǒ yí ge rén juéduì máng bú guòlái. 2. Xìngkuī wǒ bǎ zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, yàobùrán zhǎo bú dào suíshēndié, zěnme kāihuì ne?
examples.english: 1. Thanks to your help, otherwise I definitely wouldn't be able to handle it alone. 2. Fortunately, I saved all the data in the cloud; otherwise, if I couldn't find the USB drive, how could we have the meeting?

examples.chinese: 我們約好下星期一在線上開會，討論辦員工運動會的事情。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yuēhǎo xià xīngqīyī zài xiànshàng kāihuì, tǎolùn bàn yuángōng yùndònghuì de shìqing.
examples.english: We agreed to hold a meeting online next Monday to discuss the matter of organizing the employees' sports meet.

examples.chinese: 開會時他遲到了，只好悄悄地坐在會議室後面。
examples.pinyin: Kāihuì shí tā chídào le, zhǐhǎo qiāoqiāo de zuò zài huìyìshì hòumiàn.
examples.english: He was late for the meeting, so he had no choice but to quietly sit at the back of the conference room.

examples.chinese: 開會前經理要求大家勿開手機，專心討論會議內容。
examples.pinyin: Kāihuì qián jīnglǐ yāoqiú dàjiā wù kāi shǒujī, zhuānxīn tǎolùn huìyì nèiróng.
examples.english: Before the meeting, the manager asked everyone not to turn on their cell phones and to focus on discussing the meeting content.

examples.chinese: 連經理很講話，開會時老是說個不停，別人都沒說話的分。
examples.pinyin: Lián jīnglǐ hěn jiǎng huà, kāihuì shí lǎoshì shuō gè bù tíng, biérén dōu méi shuōhuà de fèn.
examples.english: Manager Lian talks a lot; during meetings he never stops talking, and others have no share of the speaking.

examples.chinese: 等一會兒開會時麻煩你負責打字，把開會的內容記錄下來。
examples.pinyin: Děng yīhuìr kāihuì shí máfan nǐ fùzé dǎzì, bǎ kāihuì de nèiróng jìlù xiàlái.
examples.english: When the meeting starts in a moment, please be responsible for typing and record the meeting content.

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？昨天晚上沒睡好嗎？ B:嗯。要不是開夜車趕報告， 現在也不會這麼沒精神。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Zuótiān wǎnshang méi shuì hǎo ma? B: Ńg. Yàobùshì kāi yèchē gǎn bàogào, xiànzài yě bù huì zhème méi jīngshén.
examples.english: A: What's wrong with you? Didn't you sleep well last night? B: Mm. If I hadn't stayed up late driving to finish my report, I wouldn't be so low on energy now.

examples.chinese: 哥哥的性格開朗、樂觀，遇到麻煩也不會往壞處想。
examples.pinyin: Gēge de xìnggé kāilǎng, lèguān, yùdào máfan yě bù huì wǎng huàichù xiǎng.
examples.english: My older brother has a cheerful and optimistic personality; even when he encounters trouble, he won't think about the bad side.

examples.chinese: 那家店的門是自動的，只要站到門前就會自動打開。這棟大樓有安全系統的設備，小偷進去就會自動發出警告的聲音通知警察。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de mén shì zìdòng de, zhǐyào zhàn dào mén qián jiù huì zìdòng dǎkāi. Zhè dòng dàlóu yǒu ānquán xìtǒng de shèbèi, xiǎotōu jìnqù jiù huì zìdòng fāchū jǐnggào de shēngyīn tōngzhī jǐngchá.
examples.english: The door of that shop is automatic; as soon as you stand in front of the door, it will open automatically. This building has safety system equipment; if a thief enters, it will automatically emit a warning sound to notify the police.

examples.chinese: 那輛腳踏車對個子小的我來說太高了，腳很難跨過去。我們大學前年起已開放跨校選課，增加各校的交流機會。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng jiǎotàchē duì gèzi xiǎo de wǒ lái shuō tài gāo le, jiǎo hěn nán kuà guòqù. Wǒmen dàxué qiánnián qǐ yǐ kāifàng kuàxiào xuǎnkè, zēngjiā gè xiào de jiāoliú jīhuì.
examples.english: That bicycle is too high for me, since I'm short, so it's hard to straddle my leg over it. Our university has offered cross-school course selection since the year before last, increasing opportunities for exchange between schools.

examples.chinese: 太太：要是你閒著沒事，就幫我泡一壺熱茶吧。先生：我哪裡閒？我馬上要開雲端會議了，可是忙得很呢！
examples.pinyin: Tàitai: Yàoshi nǐ xián zhe méishì, jiù bāng wǒ pào yī hú rè chá ba. Xiānsheng: Wǒ nǎlǐ xián? Wǒ mǎshàng yào kāi yúnduān huìyì le, kěshì máng de hěn ne!
examples.english: Wife: If you're idle with nothing to do, then help me brew a pot of hot tea. Husband: How am I idle? I'm about to start a cloud meeting; I'm really busy!

examples.chinese: 為了發展工業而不斷開發，這樣下去森林早晚會被破壞光的。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fāzhǎn gōngyè ér bùduàn kāifā, zhèyàng xiàqù sēnlín zǎowǎn huì bèi pòhuài guāng de.
examples.english: Developing industry by constantly exploiting resources, if this continues, the forests will sooner or later be completely destroyed.

examples.chinese: 當你願意開放自己的心時， 你所見的世界也會更加地美妙。
examples.pinyin: Dāng nǐ yuànyì kāifàng zìjǐ de xīn shí, nǐ suǒ jiàn de shìjiè yě huì gèngjiā de měimiào.
examples.english: When you are willing to open your heart, the world you see will also become even more wonderful.

examples.chinese: 那個小孩一看到大狗，就嚇得哭起來了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎohái yí kàn dào dà gǒu, jiù xià de kū qǐlái le.
examples.english: As soon as that child saw the big dog, he was so scared that he started crying.

examples.english: 1. The sound of firecrackers is very scary; it scared the child to tears. 2. When the midnight bell rings at twelve o'clock, we will set off firecrackers to celebrate the New Year.

examples.pinyin: 1. Biānpào de shēngyīn hěn kěpà, bǎ háizi xià de kū qǐlái le. 2. Děng bànyè shí'èr diǎn de zhōngshēng yì xiǎng, wǒmen jiù yào fàng biānpào qìngzhù xīnnián le.
examples.english: 1. The sound of firecrackers is very scary; it scared the child to tears. 2. When the midnight bell rings at twelve o'clock, we will set off firecrackers to celebrate the New Year.

examples.chinese: 早上開車去上班時，忽然有隻狗從路口跑出來，把我嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang kāichē qù shàngbān shí, hūrán yǒu zhī gǒu cóng lùkǒu pǎo chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yí tiào.
examples.english: When I was driving to work this morning, a dog suddenly ran out from the intersection and gave me a shock.

examples.chinese: 經理這次願意採用新員工的建議，讓我們都嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ zhè cì yuànyì cǎiyòng xīn yuángōng de jiànyì, ràng wǒmen dōu xià le yí tiào.
examples.english: The manager is willing to adopt the new employee's suggestion this time, which gave us all a start.

examples.chinese: 那輛汽車突然從路口開了出來， 把我嚇了一跳。聽說經理後天就要離開公司了。 這個消息太突然了，大家一時沒辦法接受。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng qìchē tūrán cóng lùkǒu kāi le chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yī tiào. Tīngshuō jīnglǐ hòutiān jiù yào líkāi gōngsī le. Zhège xiāoxi tài tūrán le, dàjiā yīshí méi bànfǎ jiēshòu.
examples.english: That car suddenly drove out from the intersection and startled me. I heard that the manager is leaving the company the day after tomorrow. This news is too sudden; everyone couldn't accept it for a moment.

examples.chinese: 何小姐走路回家時發覺有人跟在她後面，嚇得她趕快跑進便利商店，不敢回家了。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě zǒulù huí jiā shí fājué yǒu rén gēn zài tā hòumiàn, xià de tā gǎnkuài pǎo jìn biànlì shāngdiàn, bù gǎn huí jiā le.
examples.english: When Miss He was walking home, she came to know that someone was following behind her, which scared her so much that she quickly ran into a convenience store and didn't dare go home.

examples.chinese: 我把房間裡那條黑色繩子看成蛇，嚇了我一大跳。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ fángjiān lǐ nà tiáo hēisè shéngzi kàn chéng shé, xià le wǒ yī dà tiào.
examples.english: I mistook that black rope in the room for a snake and got a big scare.

examples.chinese: 那個甜點的顏色像鮮血一樣，讓我嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Nàge tiándiǎn de yánsè xiàng xiānxuè yīyàng, ràng wǒ xiàle yī tiào.
examples.english: The color of that dessert was like fresh blood, which gave me a fright.

examples.chinese: 上課的時候，如果你有問題就舉手問老師。
examples.pinyin: Shàngkè de shíhou, rúguǒ nǐ yǒu wèntí jiù jǔ shǒu wèn lǎoshī.
examples.english: During class, if you have a question, just raise your hand and ask the teacher.

examples.chinese: 高雄是台灣南部最大的城市，舉辦過世界運動會。
examples.pinyin: Gāoxióng shì Táiwān nánbù zuì dà de chéngshì, jǔbànguò Shìjiè Yùndònghuì.
examples.english: Kaohsiung is the largest city in southern Taiwan and has held the World Games.

examples.chinese: 在德國舉辦的歐洲足球比賽，一共有十二個國家報名。
examples.pinyin: Zài Déguó jǔbàn de Ōuzhōu zúqiú bǐsài, yígòng yǒu shí'èr ge guójiā bàomíng.
examples.english: For the European football match held in Germany, a total of twelve countries registered.

examples.chinese: 超商常舉辦送小禮物或買一送一的活動，可是對王先生完全沒有吸引力。
examples.pinyin: Chāoshāng cháng jǔbàn sòng xiǎo lǐwù huò mǎi yī sòng yī de huódòng, kěshì duì Wáng xiānsheng wánquán méiyǒu xīyǐnlì.
examples.english: Convenience stores often hold promotions giving small gifts or buy-one-get-one-free, but they have completely no appeal to Mr. Wang.

examples.chinese: 世界運動會的規模很大，每回舉辦時，五大洲的國家都會來參加。
examples.pinyin: Shìjiè Yùndònghuì de guīmó hěn dà, měi huí jǔbàn shí, wǔ dà zhōu de guójiā dōu huì lái cānjiā.
examples.english: The scale of the World Games is very large; each time it is held, countries from five continents come to participate.

examples.chinese: 這次社區的中秋節活動，決定在戶外舉辦，萬一下雨了就搬到室內去。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shèqū de Zhōngqiūjié huódòng, juédìng zài hùwài jǔbàn, wànyī xià yǔ le jiù bān dào shìnèi qù.
examples.english: This community Mid-Autumn Festival event has been decided to be held outdoors; if it rains, it will be moved indoors.

examples.chinese: 王老闆舉辦了一個免費吃鬆餅的活動，目的是調查哪種口味的鬆餅最受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎobǎn jǔbàn le yīgè miǎnfèi chī sōngbǐng de huódòng, mùdì shì diàochá nǎ zhǒng kǒuwèi de sōngbǐng zuì shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Boss Wang held an event with free waffles; the purpose was to investigate which flavor of waffle is most popular.

examples.chinese: 參加這次總統選舉的人實力都不錯，最後是陳先生當選了。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā zhè cì zǒngtǒng xuǎnjǔ de rén shílì dōu bùcuò, zuìhòu shì Chén xiānsheng dāngxuǎn le.
examples.english: The people who participated in this presidential election all had good qualifications; in the end, Mr. Chen was elected.

examples.chinese: 臺北美術館最近舉辦了很有名的畫展，吸引了很多民眾去欣賞那些畫。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi Měishùguǎn zuìjìn jǔbàn le hěn yǒumíng de huàzhǎn, xīyǐn le hěn duō mínzhòng qù xīnshǎng nàxiē huà.
examples.english: The Taipei Fine Arts Museum recently held a very famous painting exhibition, attracting many people to go appreciate those paintings.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的菜不僅平價，還很營養，常常中午十二點前舉客滿了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài bùjǐn píngjià, hái hěn yíngyǎng, chángcháng zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn qián jiù kèmǎn le.
examples.english: This restaurant's dishes are not only affordable but also very nutritious; it is often full before 12 noon.

examples.chinese: 這堂語法課的內容比較難，學生有任何問題都可以舉手請教老師。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng yǔfǎ kè de nèiróng bǐjiào nán, xuéshēng yǒu rènhé wèntí dōu kěyǐ jǔshǒu qǐngjiào lǎoshī.
examples.english: The content of this grammar class is relatively difficult; students can raise their hands to ask the teacher for advice if they have any questions.

examples.chinese: 你知道第一次世界運動會是在哪裡舉行的嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào dì yī cì shìjiè yùndònghuì shì zài nǎlǐ jǔxíng de ma?
examples.english: Do you know where the first World Games were held?

examples.chinese: 明天的主管會議在三樓的會議室舉行，經理要求大家不要遲到。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de zhǔguǎn huìyì zài sān lóu de huìyìshì jǔxíng, jīnglǐ yāoqiú dàjiā búyào chídào.
examples.english: Tomorrow's supervisor meeting will be held in the meeting room on the third floor; the manager requires everyone not to be late.

examples.chinese: 阿姨的婚禮明天下午兩點在教堂舉行，這個重要時刻我一定不能遲到。
examples.pinyin: Āyí de hūnlǐ míngtiān xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn zài jiàotáng jǔxíng, zhège zhòngyào shíkè wǒ yīdìng bùnéng chídào.
examples.english: Auntie's wedding will be held at the church at two o'clock tomorrow afternoon; I absolutely must not be late for this important moment.

examples.chinese: 我看見路口有人舉著一面牌子，上面是銷售房屋的廣告。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kànjiàn lùkǒu yǒu rén jǔ zhe yī miàn páizi, shàngmiàn shì xiāoshòu fángwū de guǎnggào.
examples.english: I saw someone at the intersection holding up a sign, on which was an advertisement for selling houses.

examples.chinese: 大型體育活動常選擇在都市舉行，主要原因是交通方便。
examples.pinyin: Dàxíng tǐyù huódòng cháng xuǎnzé zài dūshì jǔxíng, zhǔyào yuányīn shì jiāotōng fāngbiàn.
examples.english: Large-scale sports events are often chosen to be held in cities; the main reason is convenient transportation.

examples.chinese: 我們全家都是信基督教的，不論教會舉辦什麼活動，我們都一定去參加。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen quánjiā dōu shì xìn Jīdūjiào de, bùlùn jiàohuì jǔbàn shénme huódòng, wǒmen dōu yīdìng qù cānjiā.
examples.english: Our whole family is Christian; no matter what activities the church holds, we always go to participate.

examples.chinese: 他贏了這次選舉只是運氣好罷了，其實他沒什麼能力。
examples.pinyin: Tā yíng le zhè cì xuǎnjǔ zhǐshì yùnqi hǎo bàle, qíshí tā méi shénme nénglì.
examples.english: He won this election only because he was lucky, that's all; actually, he doesn't have much ability.

examples.chinese: 網路商店時常在過節時舉辦降價活動來吸引顧客。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn shícháng zài guòjié shí jǔbàn jiàngjià huódòng lái xīyǐn gùkè.
examples.english: Online stores often hold discount events during festivals to attract customers.

examples.chinese: 他希望能在海邊舉辦婚禮，可是一直找不到理想的場地。
examples.pinyin: Tā xīwàng néng zài hǎibiān jǔbàn hūnlǐ, kěshì yīzhí zhǎo bù dào lǐxiǎng de chǎngdì.
examples.english: He hopes to hold his wedding by the seaside, but he has not been able to find an ideal venue.

items.wordHook: Combining 國(country) and 中(middle): 國中 means junior high school.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風引起的水災太嚴重，害大家一連五天沒有乾淨的水可以用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng yǐnqǐ de shuǐzāi tài yánzhòng, hài dàjiā yīlián wǔ tiān méiyǒu gānjìng de shuǐ kěyǐ yòng.
examples.english: The flood caused by this typhoon was too serious, causing everyone to go five days in a row without clean water to use.

examples.chinese: 真正的朋友會幫助你、關心你，是絕對不會傷害你的。青少年常因為不了解而誤會父母的教育方式，或許等他們長大了，就能真正明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu huì bāngzhù nǐ, guānxīn nǐ, shì juéduì bù huì shānghài nǐ de. Qīngshàonián cháng yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér wùhuì fùmǔ de jiàoyù fāngshì, huòxǔ děng tāmen zhǎngdà le, jiù néng zhēnzhèng míngbai le.
examples.english: True friends will help you and care about you; they will absolutely not hurt you. Teenagers often misunderstand their parents' way of education because they don't understand; perhaps when they grow up, they will truly understand.

examples.chinese: 今天藝術系的學生要在學校的禮堂，演出跟十二生肖有關的故事。 那名演員很厲害，在那部電影裡一個人演出三個角色。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān yìshù xì de xuéshēng yào zài xuéxiào de lǐtáng, yǎnchū gēn shí'èr shēngxiào yǒuguān de gùshì. Nà míng yǎnyuán hěn lìhài, zài nà bù diànyǐng lǐ yīgè rén yǎnchū sān gè juésè.
examples.english: Today the art department students are going to perform a story related to the twelve zodiac signs in the school auditorium. That actor is very impressive; in that movie, he performed three roles by himself.

examples.chinese: 警察的工作主要是保護民眾，讓好人不被傷害。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá de gōngzuò zhǔyào shì bǎohù mínzhòng, ràng hǎorén bù bèi shānghài.
examples.english: The police's job is mainly to protect the public, so that good people are not hurt.

examples.chinese: 那個孩子可真勇敢！連看到蛇也不害怕。
examples.pinyin: Nàge háizi kě zhēn yǒnggǎn! Lián kàn dào shé yě bú hàipà.
examples.english: That child is certainly brave! He is not even afraid when he sees a snake.

examples.chinese: 山本良介很厲害，早上剛學的五十個生字全部都記得了！
examples.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè hěn lìhài, zǎoshang gāng xué de wǔshí ge shēngzì quánbù dōu jìde le!
examples.english: Yamamoto Ryosuke is really impressive; he remembers all fifty new characters he just learned this morning!

examples.chinese: 他不敢約女生出去，或許是因為太害羞了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù gǎn yuē nǚshēng chūqù, huòxǔ shì yīnwèi tài hàixiū le.
examples.english: He doesn't dare to ask girls out; perhaps it's because he is too shy.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"林小姐弄錯了約會的時間，所以遲到了半個小時。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"我覺得「害怕」跟「可怕」的意思差不多，所以常弄錯。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě nòngcuò le yuēhuì de shíjiān, suǒyǐ chídào le bàn ge xiǎoshí. Wǒ juéde “hàipà” gēn “kěpà” de yìsi chàbuduō, suǒyǐ cháng nòngcuò.
examples.english: Miss Lin made a mistake about the appointment time, so she was half an hour late. I think “afraid” and “scary” have similar meanings, so I often misunderstand.

examples.chinese: 她很害羞，不敢跟不認識的人說話。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn hàixiū, bù gǎn gēn bù rènshi de rén shuōhuà.
examples.english: She is very shy and doesn't dare talk to people she doesn't know.

examples.chinese: 天黑了，那個小孩子很害怕，不敢一個人去上廁所。
examples.pinyin: Tiān hēi le, nàge xiǎoháizi hěn hàipà, bù gǎn yīgè rén qù shàng cèsuǒ.
examples.english: It got dark, and that child was very afraid; he didn't dare go to the bathroom alone.

examples.chinese: 天黑了，那個小孩子很害怕，不敢一個人去上廁所。
examples.pinyin: Tiān hēi le, nàge xiǎoháizi hěn hàipà, bù gǎn yīgè rén qù shàng cèsuǒ.
examples.english: It got dark, and that child was very afraid; he didn't dare go to the bathroom alone.

examples.chinese: 那個人喝了酒還開車，結果造成嚴重的車禍，害兩個人不幸死了，真可惡！
examples.pinyin: Nàge rén hē le jiǔ hái kāichē, jiéguǒ zàochéng yánzhòng de chēhuò, hài liǎng ge rén bùxìng sǐ le, zhēn kěwù!
examples.english: That person drank alcohol and still drove, resulting in a serious car accident that caused two people to die tragically; how detestable!

examples.chinese: 那對雙胞胎長得很像，個性卻很不同，哥哥很大方，弟弟很害羞。
examples.pinyin: Nà duì shuāngbāotāi zhǎng de hěn xiàng, gèxìng què hěn bùtóng, gēge hěn dàfāng, dìdi hěn hàixiū.
examples.english: That pair of twins look very much alike, but their personalities are very different: the older brother is very outgoing, and the younger brother is very shy.

examples.chinese: 有人設計出地震的警告系統，減少了地震帶來的傷害，這樣的成就真是了不起。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shèjì chū dìzhèn de jǐnggào xìtǒng, jiǎnshǎo le dìzhèn dàilái de shānghài, zhèyàng de chéngjiù zhēn shì liǎobuqǐ.
examples.english: Someone designed an earthquake warning system that reduced the damage caused by earthquakes; such an achievement is truly amazing.

examples.chinese: 路邊的攝影機錄到了房先生發生車禍的經過，讓警察順利抓到了害他受傷的人。
examples.pinyin: Lùbiān de shèyǐngjī lù dào le Fáng xiānsheng fāshēng chēhuò de jīngguò, ràng jǐngchá shùnlì zhuā dào le hài tā shòushāng de rén.
examples.english: The roadside camera recorded the course of Mr. Fang's car accident, allowing the police to smoothly catch the person who injured him.

examples.chinese: 每個人的一生都應該好好規劃，日子才不會白白地過去。導遊忘了跟小湯約好在紅毛城門口見面，害他白（白）等了一個小時。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de yīshēng dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guīhuà, rìzi cái bù huì báibái de guòqù. Dǎoyóu wàng le gēn Xiǎo Tāng yuēhǎo zài Hóngmáochéng ménkǒu jiànmiàn, hài tā bái (bái) děng le yī gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Everyone should plan their life well so that days won't pass for nothing. The tour guide forgot to agree to meet Xiao Tang at the entrance of Fort San Domingo, causing him to wait in vain for an hour.

examples.chinese: 上週末我們去爬山，走到半路時忽然吹起大風來，害我們不得不下山。
examples.pinyin: Shàng zhōumò wǒmen qù páshān, zǒu dào bànlù shí hūrán chuī qǐ dàfēng lái, hài wǒmen bùdébù xiàshān.
examples.english: Last weekend we went mountain climbing, and when we had walked halfway, suddenly a strong wind started blowing, which forced us to have to go down the mountain.

examples.chinese: 手機雖然使生活更便利，但過度使用也可能傷害身心健康。人類過度的發展活動，已對動植物的生活環境造成嚴重破壞。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī suīrán shǐ shēnghuó gèng biànlì, dàn guòdù shǐyòng yě kěnéng shānghài shēnxīn jiànkāng. Rénlèi guòdù de fāzhǎn huódòng, yǐ duì dòngzhíwù de shēnghuó huánjìng zàochéng yánzhòng pòhuài.
examples.english: Although mobile phones make life more convenient, excessive use may also harm physical and mental health. Humans' excessive development activities have already caused serious damage to the living environments of animals and plants.

examples.chinese: 跟朋友飲酒是一件開心的事，不過飲酒過度卻可能傷害身體。
examples.pinyin: Gēn péngyǒu yǐn jiǔ shì yí jiàn kāixīn de shì, búguò yǐn jiǔ guòdù què kěnéng shānghài shēntǐ.
examples.english: Drinking alcohol with friends is a happy thing, but excessive drinking may harm your health.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生很厲害，一隻手能端好幾個盤子。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de fúwùshēng hěn lìhài, yī zhī shǒu néng duān hǎo jǐ gè pánzi.
examples.english: The waiter at that restaurant is very impressive; he can hold several plates level with one hand.

examples.chinese: 早上在草地上散步，突然看見一條蛇經過，害得我一直流冷汗。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang zài cǎodì shàng sànbù, tūrán kànjiàn yī tiáo shé jīngguò, hàide wǒ yīzhí liú lěnghàn.
examples.english: While walking on the grass this morning, I suddenly saw a snake pass by, which made me keep breaking out in a cold sweat.

examples.chinese: 這次傳染病的病毒很厲害，出門得戴著口罩，免得被傳染。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chuánrǎnbìng de bìngdú hěn lìhài, chūmén děi dàizhe kǒuzhào, miǎnde bèi chuánrǎn.
examples.english: The virus of this infectious disease is very severe; when going out, you must wear a mask so as not to get infected.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠排出的黑煙不只氣味難聞，更可怕的是可能對肺部造成傷害。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng pái chū de hēiyān bùzhǐ qìwèi nánwén, gèng kěpà de shì kěnéng duì fèibù zàochéng shānghài.
examples.english: The black smoke emitted by that factory not only smells bad, but even more frighteningly, it may cause harm to the lungs.

examples.chinese: 你別看她一臉害羞的樣子，在熟人面前她可是很開朗的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié kàn tā yī liǎn hàixiū de yàngzi, zài shúrén miànqián tā kěshì hěn kāilǎng de.
examples.english: Don't judge her by her shy appearance; in front of acquaintances she is actually very cheerful.

examples.chinese: 這個字不好念，我重複了好幾次，同學都說不對，害我好想放棄。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zì bù hǎo niàn, wǒ chóngfù le hǎo jǐ cì, tóngxué dōu shuō bù duì, hài wǒ hǎo xiǎng fàngqì.
examples.english: This character is hard to pronounce; I repeated it several times, and my classmates all said it was wrong, which made me really want to give up.

examples.chinese: 潮溼的居住環境不僅使家具不容易保養，並且更可能傷害人體健康。
examples.pinyin: Cháoshī de jūzhù huánjìng bùjǐn shǐ jiājù bù róngyì bǎoyǎng, bìngqiě gèng kěnéng shānghài réntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: A damp living environment not only makes it difficult to maintain furniture, but is also more likely to harm human health.

items.wordHook: A 宀(roof) over a 龶(growing plant) and a 口(mouth): its growth is the 害(cause) of the 口(mouth)'s complaint.

examples.chinese: 個子小的人，不見得力量也小。
examples.pinyin: Gèzi xiǎo de rén, bújiànde lìliàng yě xiǎo.
examples.english: People who are small in stature are not necessarily small in strength.

examples.chinese: 老是忘記東西不見得是因為個性迷糊，也可能與健康有關。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshì wàngjì dōngxi bù jiànde shì yīnwèi gèxìng míhú, yě kěnéng yǔ jiànkāng yǒuguān.
examples.english: Always forgetting things is not necessarily because of an absentminded personality; it may also be related to health.

examples.chinese: 動物的體溫不見得都是不變的，像蛇的體溫就隨著環境而變。
examples.pinyin: Dòngwù de tǐwēn bù jiàndé dōu shì bùbiàn de, xiàng shé de tǐwēn jiù suízhe huánjìng ér biàn.
examples.english: Animal body temperatures are not necessarily constant; for example, a snake's body temperature changes with the environment.

examples.chinese: 就算擁有高收入，也不見得能讓你過著幸福美好的生活。
examples.pinyin: Jiùsuàn yōngyǒu gāo shōurù, yě bújiàndé néng ràng nǐ guòzhe xìngfú měihǎo de shēnghuó.
examples.english: Even if you have a high income, it does not necessarily mean you can live a happy and wonderful life.

examples.chinese: 世界各地的神話雖然不見得都真實，卻能讓人們多少了解一些古代的風俗習慣。
examples.pinyin: Shìjiè gèdì de shénhuà suīrán bú jiàndé dōu zhēnshí, què néng ràng rénmen duōshǎo liǎojiě yīxiē gǔdài de fēngsú xíguàn.
examples.english: Although myths from around the world are not necessarily all true, they can still let people understand some ancient customs and habits to some extent.

examples.chinese: 學校規定新生必須在開學前一週完成註冊手續。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào guīdìng xīnshēng bìxū zài kāixué qián yī zhōu wánchéng zhùcè shǒuxù.
examples.english: The school stipulates that new students must complete the registration procedures one week before the semester starts.

examples.chinese: 註了冊以後，新生要把相關證件各影印一份，交給學校。
examples.pinyin: Zhù le cè yǐhòu, xīnshēng yào bǎ xiāngguān zhèngjiàn gè yǐngyìn yī fèn, jiāo gěi xuéxiào.
examples.english: After registering, new students must photocopy one copy of each relevant document and submit them to the school.

examples.chinese: 我們國家出口的農產品很有名，不但價格低，品質又好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen guójiā chūkǒu de nóngchǎnpǐn hěn yǒumíng, bùdàn jiàgé dī, pǐnzhì yòu hǎo.
examples.english: The agricultural products our country exports are very famous; not only is the price low, but the quality is also good.

examples.chinese: 自從住校以後，我得學習自己收拾、整理房間。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng zhùxiào yǐhòu, wǒ děi xuéxí zìjǐ shōushi, zhěnglǐ fángjiān.
examples.english: Ever since I started living at school, I have had to learn to tidy up and organize my room myself.

examples.chinese: 要前往國外旅行，得先確認當地現在的氣候，好收拾行李。
examples.pinyin: Yào qiánwǎng guówài lǚxíng, děi xiān quèrèn dāngdì xiànzài de qìhòu, hǎo shōushí xínglǐ.
examples.english: To go abroad for travel, you must first confirm the local current climate so as to pack your luggage.

items.wordHook: Step up and 登(rise) onto a sturdy low 几(table) to take a comfortable seat: 凳(bench).
a 𠂇(left hand) lifts food toward a 口(mouth) → the hand you eat with is 右(the right side).
A 丆(cliff edge) drops a chunk that lands as a 口(mouth)-shaped rock: 石(stone).
An arrow flies with 一(one) 厶(private) aim until striking the 土(soil) where you 至(reach) your goal.
a 口(gate) blocks a 止(stop) sign while a 兆(omen) leaps → 跳(hop).
To 還(also) a 有(have): 還有 means and, also, plus.
a 立(stand) sets a 日(sun) on a rooftop → 音(sound).
